item.title: Indian student shot dead in random attack near University of Toronto
item.description: The Indian Embassy issued a statement saying, "We express our deepest condolences on the tragic death of young Indian doctoral student Shivank Awasthi in a shooting incident near the University of Toronto Scarborough campus. The Embassy is in touch with the bereaved family during this difficult time and is coordinating with local authorities to provide all necessary assistance."

item.title: Nepal condemns Hindu persecution in Bangladesh: Religious leaders call it a crime against humanity
item.description: The protest, which began at the Janaki Temple complex in the ancient city of Janakpur, saw protesters chanting slogans demanding justice for Deepu Chandra Das, a Hindu youth killed in Bangladesh.

item.title: Gold prices rise again in India, Silver jumps sharply; Check rates here
item.description: Gold prices continued their upward trend in India on December 26, with 24-carat gold touching ₹139,410 per 10 grams in Delhi. Strong global cues and central bank buying supported prices. Silver also surged sharply.

item.title: Libyan military chief among 8 killed in plane crash in Turkey; Black box under investigation
item.description: The private jet carrying General Muhammad Ali Ahmed al-Haddad, the military chief of western Libya, four other military officers, and three crew members, crashed on Tuesday after taking off from Ankara, the Turkish capital. All those on board were killed.

item.title: Indian Stock Market opens lower; Sensex, Nifty trade in red
item.description: Indian stock markets opened lower on Friday with the Sensex and Nifty slipping amid weak global cues and profit booking. The rupee also weakened against the US dollar. Market sentiment remained cautious as most sectoral indices traded in the red.

item.title: Mexico: 10 dead, 32 injured in tragic bus crash in Veracruz
item.description: The local municipality has also released the names of those injured, along with the hospitals to which they were transported for medical care. The injured passengers are being treated for a range of injuries, and several are said to be in critical condition.

item.title: Zepto IPO set to challenge Zomato and Swiggy in Stock Market; DRHP filing soon
item.description: Quick commerce startup Zepto is preparing to enter the stock market with a potential IPO worth over ₹11,000 crore. The company is reportedly filing its draft papers with SEBI through the confidential route.

item.title: “This hypocrisy will destroy us,” says Janhvi Kapoor on Bangladesh violence
item.description: Indian celebrities have condemned the lynching of Hindu man Dipu Chandra Das in Bangladesh, calling it barbaric and questioning global silence. The incident has raised serious concerns over minority safety amid rising tensions ahead of elections.

item.title: Rajasthan: Tension in Chomu after mob pelts stones at Police; Full inside story
item.description: Police arrived at the scene to try and calm the situation, but the dispute escalated, and the crowd began pelting stones at the police. Several police officers were injured in the incident.

item.title: Vaibhav Suryavanshi withdraws from Vijay Hazare Trophy after stunning 190; Know why
item.description: Bihar’s young batting sensation Vaibhav Suryavanshi grabbed headlines with a stunning 190-run knock on his Vijay Hazare Trophy debut. Soon after, he withdrew from the tournament for a special reason - his selection for the Prime Minister’s National Child Award.
